final:
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 1
  post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  let (tx, rx) = Channel[int](cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    tx.try_send(x) else break
    n += 1
  n
